methodology.scope: Only the six explicitly pinned all-medium sessions: retained twenty Opus/Sonnet rounds plus forty selected medium Fable reruns. Original Fable-high series, additional session_fcc7bb2f60a8, and partial/restarted sessions are excluded.
methodology.effort: All twelve participant model/effort identities are checked against archived verification sidecars citing actual Claude API request/response metadata and source-log hashes. This public analyzer validates the sidecar evidence; the separate cost audit reopens the private logs.
methodology.identity: Exact Claude model IDs and Claude Code harness parsed from summary.coding_assistant_1/2, not blank player_N_model fields.
methodology.accuracy: Pooled shots hit / pooled shots fired; not an average of per-round percentages.
methodology.damage_differential: (Total damage dealt - opponent damage dealt) / appearances.
methodology.decision_time: Pooled inferred_decision_turns whose intent_call_id resolves to set_participant_plan: observation completion to plan call start, seconds. Includes retries, rejected plans, orchestration, and post-finish attempts; not pure model inference latency or time to a valid plan.
methodology.p95: Linear interpolation between sorted samples at index (n - 1) * 0.95 (Hyndman-Fan type 7).
methodology.route_rejection_rate: Invalid routes / (accepted plans + invalid routes). Every recorded attempted call including retries is counted. Post-finish and run mismatch failures are excluded from both numerator and denominator.
methodology.failure_classification: accepted:false is a rejection even if is_error:false. Unknown failures stop analysis for manual review.
methodology.mcp_flagged_errors: Calls with is_error:true, including operational tool failures. This excludes accepted:false route validation responses and is not a route-rejection metric. Participant counts exclude get_match_result calls with no participant_id.
methodology.timestamps: Stats started_at_ms is run initialization, not necessarily combat start. generated_at_ms is the last telemetry snapshot, not necessarily combat end. Exported ISO timestamps are UTC.
methodology.prompt_hashes: Raw prompt file SHA256 hashes. Prompts contain dynamic controller tokens, participant assignments, aliases, and round context, so different hashes alone do not demonstrate different instruction templates. Raw prompt contents/tokens are not copied into this analysis.
methodology.normalized_game_instruction_hashes: Separately hash each saved prompt from BENCHMARK ISOLATION to EOF after replacing controller_token argument values with a fixed placeholder. This checks the game-instruction body, not the preceding identity/alias/round header. No source prompt is modified.
methodology.costs: No token or cost estimates are produced by this script.

caveats: The first Opus-versus-Sonnet round has no config.json or saved participant prompts. Its summary still supplies model identities, seed, timeout, and result, but full settings and prompt wording for that round cannot be independently verified from those artifacts.

431 accepted plan-call records coexist with 429 intent lifecycle records; 2 rounds differ. Accepted-call counts do not prove that each call produced a distinct executed lifecycle. This report uses per-call outcomes for plan/error rates and preserves the discrepancy.
Stats rationales_logged is zero throughout. This field is not evidence that the models performed no reasoning, and no tactical causal claims are derived from it.
analysis_summary pickup counts are not used: its text-matching parser can match words such as shotgun in plan text rather than actual pickup events.
No token usage is recorded in any stats.json. Arena call counts alone cannot determine model token consumption or cost.

Decision intervals include opening-plan preparation and post-finish attempts. The largest intervals and whether they precede the first accepted plan are exported for inspection. Reused observations make retry intervals dependent; samples are retained rather than trimmed.
The model IDs are reported benchmark identities; arena artifacts do not attest provider-side serving configuration, reasoning effort, or model weights.
This is a descriptive agent-system benchmark with shared route execution, fixed seed/spawn setting, and continuing sessions; rounds are not independent randomized model trials.
